responsibility: Defines the large set of machine-description iterators and related attributes used throughout the Arm backend’s .md files. It groups scalar, vector, Neon, IWMMXT, MVE, BF16, predicate, and unspec opcode families into reusable mode/code/int iterators so instruction patterns in arm.md, neon.md, mve.md, and related files can be generated compactly across many operand modes and operation variants.
